demonstrates: Generalised a single-subject risk-prediction service into a pluggable architecture and proved it by adding two further domains behind one protocol without editing the shared training, explainability or streaming machinery, with twelve model backends swappable per request behind a single interface.

claims.section: Twelve model backends behind one interface
claims.note: Total model backends: 7 classifiers plus 5 regressors. Re-verified 2026-09-12 and unchanged.

claims.section: Twelve model backends behind one interface
claims.note: Classifiers, cross-checked two ways that agree: the Literal lists seven and seven backend directories exist across the two libraries.
